description: Retrieval cases plus manual AI behavior expectations. The script verifies retrieval only; run prompts in fresh AI sessions to assess reasoning.

cases.prompt: Plan the layer arrangement before routing my four-layer board.
cases.ai_expectation: Establish signal and fabrication requirements; do not assert a universal four-layer stackup.

cases.prompt: How should I choose a stackup?
cases.query: How should I choose a stackup?
cases.ai_expectation: Retrieve guidance, establish missing inputs and distinguish examples from requirements.

cases.prompt: Can I route this fast signal over a ground-plane slot?
cases.ai_expectation: Inspect the selected reference plane and current return path before proposing a route.

cases.prompt: Check the decoupling layout around this IC.
cases.ai_expectation: Inspect both supply and return connections; do not invent a universal distance limit.

cases.prompt: Should I separate AGND and DGND on this ADC board?
cases.ai_expectation: Read the exact converter requirements and current paths; do not decide from pin names.

cases.prompt: Choose a trace width for my controlled-impedance route.
cases.ai_expectation: Obtain the real fabrication stackup and impedance target before choosing a width.
Establish USB version, pair nets, impedance and skew constraints; equal length is insufficient proof.

cases.prompt: My pair changes to the backside. Where do return vias go?
cases.ai_expectation: Identify the actual reference layers and connect the appropriate references; no blanket stitching pitch.

cases.prompt: Review ESD protection at the external connector.
cases.ai_expectation: Review protection selection and discharge routing; do not claim system compliance from a component rating.

cases.prompt: Place the crystal and its load capacitors.
cases.ai_expectation: Read oscillator requirements before setting geometry and capacitance.

cases.prompt: How should I separate noisy and sensitive components?
cases.ai_expectation: Use functional current paths and mechanical constraints; do not automatically split ground.

cases.prompt: What width do I need for a 20 amp power trace?
cases.ai_expectation: Report missing current-capacity coverage and obtain appropriate thermal evidence; do not substitute impedance guidance.

cases.prompt: Design my 24 GHz antenna using this library.
cases.ai_expectation: Report RF coverage is missing; do not invent geometry.
Report missing safety-standard coverage and required inputs; do not invent clearances.
